mapper.select:
SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.CUSTOMER_NAME as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('01','04') left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.CUSTOMER_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on A.SEQNO=E.SEQNO
A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= A.VDATE
AND to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') <= A.MDATE
ORDER BY customerid,vdate,creditmstid asc

SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.FINPROD_NAME as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('02') inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.FINPROD_ID left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on A.SEQNO=E.SEQNO
A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= A.VDATE
AND to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') <= A.MDATE

select MM.* from ( SELECT 'root' as pid, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt, '02' as hasChildren FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('03') inner join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on A.SEQNO=E.SEQNO
union all
SELECT A.SEQNO pid, A.FINPROD_ID customerId, A.PFLSH AS PFLSH, NULL AS creditAmt, B.VDATE VDATE, B.MDATE MDATE, C.FINPROD_ABBR as customerName, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, null as remainAmt, '01' as hasChildren FROM (select m.seqno,m.finprod_id,n.pflsh from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL m inner join CREDIT_LINES n on m.seqno=n.customer_id) A inner join CREDIT_LINES B on A.FINPROD_ID=B.CUSTOMER_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on B.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on B.SEQNO=E.SEQNO ) MM
MM.customerId IN (#{item} )
AND MM.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= MM.VDATE
AND to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') <= MM.MDATE
